title: Extranet-created room types/rate plans carry empty supplier refs — supply unaddressable and unbookable
expected: supplier_room_type_ref/supplier_rate_plan_ref uniquely address each unit of supply so search offers and prebook resolve the exact selection
actual: CreateRoomType/CreateRatePlan never set the refs (column default ""). Search advertises offers with rt_ref=""/rp_ref=""; prebook either 400s (room_type_id required) or resolves an arbitrary row where >1 room type exists — wrong price, decrement on wrong inventory
root_cause: refs stamped only for bedbank-seeded supply; self-serve extranet inserts left them at the default
fix_commit: uat/stays-a (pending commit): stamp refs=id::text at create + docs/qa/stays-uat-365/migrations-stays-a/stays_supplier_refs_backfill.pending.sql

title: Client-supplied promo_bps/loyalty_tier lets any guest self-serve up to a 20% discount
expected: discounts resolved server-side from property-configured promotions or verified codes; client cannot name its own discount
actual: POST /prebook (and /agent/quote) forwarded body.promo_bps straight into pricing.Price -> gross reduced up to MaxStackedDiscountBps=2000 with zero validation against stays_promotion
root_cause: request field trusted as a pricing input; stays_promotion rules existed but were never consulted at sale time
fix_commit: uat/stays-a: promo_bps/loyalty_tier ignored; new repo BestPromotionBps resolves active PERCENT promos server-side (verified live: promo_bps=9000 -> discount 0; property promo -> 10% applied)

title: Prebook book_token TTL advertised (10m) but never enforced — stale holds bookable forever
expected: book_token expires at the advertised TTL; expired holds re-quote
actual: decodeBookToken validated format only; ExpiresAt was cosmetic. Any leaked/stale token booked at the stale price indefinitely
root_cause: no issue timestamp inside the token
fix_commit: uat/stays-a: v2 token embeds issued unix; decode enforces bookTokenTTL=10m (ErrHoldExpired); unit test TestBookTokenTTL

title: Per-date rate_day prices/restrictions never applied at sale; occupancy unchecked; search ignores availability
expected: per-night rate calendar prices the stay; cta/ctd/min_los/max_los/stop_sell enforced; party must fit room occupancy; search excludes unsellable supply
actual: Search ignored dates/occupancy entirely (unsellable listings advertised); Prebook priced every night at base_sell_rate_kobo ignoring stays_rate_day; restrictions settable via ARI but unenforced; occupancy map dropped (gateway.Occupancy{} hardcoded) so over-capacity bookings succeeded
root_cause: SB1 calendars were write-only: nothing read them on the sale path
fix_commit: uat/stays-a: priceStay() sums rate_day cells w/ base fallback + enforces restrictions; occupancy mapped+validated; Search adds per-night EXISTS + occupancy filters (verified live 11M+7M=18M; adults=9 vs occupancy=2 -> 409)

title: realtor booking RPCs accept forged input: no client_ref dedup, no capacity check, no past-date guard, hardcoded cleaning fee
expected: retried bookings dedup on client_ref; guests<=room capacity; no past-date bookings; host-configured fees
actual: realtor_create_shortlet_booking + realtor_book_hotel_room store client_ref without checking it (retry=duplicate confirmed booking), never compare p_guests to capacity, accept past check-ins, and hardcode cleaning at NGN 25k
root_cause: RPC input trust; schema has no UNIQUE on client_ref
fix_commit: docs/qa/stays-uat-365/migrations-stays-a/realtor_rpc_hardening.pending.sql — adds dedup UNIQUEs, over_capacity + invalid_dates raises

actual: ModerateProperty writes status=ACTIVE unconditionally; eligibility is computed for display but not checked
root_cause: gate exists as a computed view, not an enforcement
